description: JavaScript functions for address auto-completion and dynamic state list fetching in a web application, specifically for country and state/province selection.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Fetches the list of countries via AJAX and initializes autocomplete.

methods.name: callCountryAutocompleter
methods.description: Sets up autocomplete for country selection using fetched data.

methods.name: setKeyAsParameterAndGetStateList
methods.description: Sets selected country ID and triggers fetching of associated states.

methods.name: getAssociatedStateListForAutoComplete
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of states/provinces for the selected country.

methods.name: callStateAutocompleter
methods.description: Configures autocomplete for state/province selection based on fetched data.

methods.name: getAssociatedStateList
methods.description: Generic function to fetch and populate state list based on country ID.
